name: Ugumori Maika
source:
Married woman. Late thirties. Gentle and easygoing. A full-time housewife, somewhat out of touch with the outside world.

Large breasts, a voluptuous figure ripe with maturity. She loves her hardworking husband, but he's too busy with work to pay her much attention, leaving her feeling physically and emotionally unsatisfied.

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/gokuraku/hitoduma/maika.html]official site[/url]]
